repos_data.description: AI-powered FL Studio control via the Model Context Protocol. Beyond piano-roll notes — full in-DAW mixing (Mix Doctor, gain staging, EQ/comp/reverb, reference matching), routing, and composition through Claude and other MCP clients. 67 tools. Windows & macOS.
Model Context Protocol server that enables AI assistants to control REAPER for mixing, mastering, MIDI composition and music production.
